descripcion: The Easy Form Builder by WhiteStudio – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via esign 'value' Field via Cross-Type 'r_matrix' Poisoning in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation is possible without authentication because the REST endpoint /wp-json/Emsfb/v1/forms/message/add is guarded only by a wp_rest nonce freely obtainable by any visitor loading the public-facing form page via efb_var.nonce. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Asset CleanUp Pro: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via 'author_name' URL segment (author archive rewrite capture) in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.8.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

A maliciously modified field in the locally stored JSON description for an update made available by Autodesk, when processed by Autodesk Access, can cause attacker-controlled HTML content to be executed in another user's session. A local, authenticated malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of another user if that user interacts with an injected link, resulting in privilege escalation. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 8.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '[] (array-valued post field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the BuddyForms form to have public submission enabled, which allows unauthenticated visitors to submit forms; the _wpnonce required by the form handler is printed in the public form HTML and is therefore accessible to any visitor, providing no meaningful authorization barrier. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.address_1' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires the E-Documents feature to be enabled with a document format selected, as this is what causes the vulnerable meta box to be rendered on the order edit screen. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that at least one prior comment from the attacker's email address has been manually approved, which under WordPress's default comment_previously_approved=1 setting causes subsequent comments from that address to be auto-approved without moderation. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'stype' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. This is possible because the plugin's mu-plugin companion (copied automatically on install when the default 'Enable Fast AJAX' option is on) defines DOING_AJAX on any front-end request carrying gd-ajax=1, and an unconditional branch in geodir_get_current_posttype() restores the attacker-controlled stype value after the allow-list check clears it, allowing the tainted value to reach the SQL sink without any preparation. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The UsersWP – Front-end login form, User Registration, User Profile & Members Directory plugin for WP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the ' of any editor-type Account field (e.g. about_work)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.83 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured at least one editor-type Account field with public visibility and directory display enabled, as no such field exists in a default installation. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The GD bbPress Tools plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'signature' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The crafted signature payload is stored verbatim in user meta and fires when an Administrator views the attacker's topic on the Edit Topic admin screen. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM
